---

![](images/profile.jpg){width="220" fig-alt="Andrea Vaiano"}

When not on a tennis court, you will find me researching quantitative models for inequality and income mobility (@Sapienza University). I am also working on a groundbreaking project to investigate the impact of Social Determinants of Health (SDoH) on patients with liver disease (@Istituto superiore di Sanità). I focus mainly on latent variables models and generalized linear models. In addition to my main research topics, I have also explored applications to Bayesian statistics, phylogenetics and sports analytics.

## Statistical projects I love and support

- [Tennisabstract](https://www.tennisabstract.com/) — A whole new statistical look at tennis
- [Ourworldindata](https://ourworldindata.org/) — Data to support meaningful change
- [Institute of Mathematical Statistics | XL Files](https://imstat.org/category/xl-files/) — Statistics meets philosophy, epistemology and the great questions worth asking
- [Fooled by randomness | Fat tails](https://www.fooledbyrandomness.com/FatTails.html/) — "Doing Statistics Under Fat Tails", or how uncertainty rules the world
